summary: Keep tool-heavy scenario turns running while the final tool call is pending

replay.detail: No daemon replay or recovery changes. The tool-heavy conversation variant now reports running rather than completed so pending shell work remains active.

schema.detail: No wire schema changes. The variant uses the existing running timeline status; committed fixtures are unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or rule changes. Kit tests reject pending tool calls following a terminal status across all worlds and conversation variants.

compatibility.detail: Existing fixture shapes and identities are unchanged; failed-tools remains waiting.

downtime.detail: No service deployment or interruption required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or recovery restrictions.
